results.incidentcategorycustomerfriendlydescript: To provide a reliable electricity supply to your property, we carry out regular inspections of our equipment in your area. This has identified poles that need replacing and upgrading. Doing this will reduce the risk of you having an unplanned power cut in the future. To ensure the power is off for the shortest possible time, our contractors Freedom may carry out preparation works prior to the power cut as we appreciate your area has been impacted with unplanned power cuts in the last 6 months. To allow our contractors to safely replace poles in your area, we will need to temporarily disconnect the generator on the 27th of July 2026. Once the work on the 27th July 2026  is finished, the temporary generator will be reconnected. After all planned works have been completed, we will then disconnect the generator on the 29th of July 2026 and return your supply to the main power network. This work is taking place near Ivy Barns Lane.

results.incidentcategorycustomerfriendlydescript: To provide a reliable electricity supply to your property, we carry out regular inspections of our equipment in your area. This has identified 2 electricity poles that need replacing and upgrading. During this time we will also be carrying out some tree trimming around the overhead electricity network where necessary. Doing this will reduce the risk of you having an unplanned power cut in the future. To carry out this work safely, we need to temporarily switch off your electricity while we work on the electricity poles, as it is not safe to do so with live electricity flowing through them. To help reduce the time the power is off, our engineers may carry out some preparation work before the planned power cut. We understand that power interruptions are inconvenient and we will do everything we can to keep disruption to a minimum. This work is taking place near Greenway Lane.
